sections.content: Common present-tense actions are expressed with indefinite conjugation: 'dolgozom' (I work), 'dolgozon' (he/she works).

items.english: I always work in the morning.

items.spanish: Én mindig reggel dolgozom, de néha otthon tanulok.
items.english: I always work in the morning, but sometimes I study at home.

sections.content: Notice that Hungarian verb forms include person information: 'dolgozom' (I), 'dolgozsz' (you), 'dolgozik' (he/she). You can often omit the subject pronoun.
